Table.Name: Command
Table.Command: select T5.CardName,T2.Phone1, T2.Phone2, T2.Cellular,T2.City, T5.Address,T4.Name, T3.Name,T1.SlpName,T1.U_Telefono, CASE WHEN T5.ObjType='14' THEN 'Devolución' end as 'Dev' from ODRF t5 INNER JOIN OSLP T1 ON T5.SlpCode = T1.SlpCode left join [@NS_PERSONALLOGIST] T3 ON t5.U_NS_EntregadoPor=T3.Code inner join OCRD T2 ON T5.CardCode = T2.CardCode left join [@NS_PLACA] T4 on t5.U_NS_Placa=T4.Code inner JOIN OINV T0 ON T0.CardCode = T5.CardCode where T5.ObjType='14' and t5.U_NS_BL like '{?Ruta}' group by T5.CardName,T2.Phone1, T2.Phone2, T2.Cellular,T2.City, T5.Address,T4.Name, T3.Name,T5.ObjType,T1.SlpName,T1.U_Telefono
